title: 56-byte record range transfer
summary: Transfers a range of 56-byte records, copying offsets 0 through 53 in ordered groups and preserving the final two bytes of each destination record. Returns the destination advanced by the number of records.
test_description: Compare the original and recovery for empty, single and multiple records, unaligned and overlapping ranges, self-copy, and safe one-record null destination. Compare entire buffers and returned offsets, including untouched trailing bytes, and verify FS head restoration after each oracle call.
known_limits: The range must terminate by 56-byte increments; malformed ranges and null destination with multiple records can access invalid memory and are not tested.
The original uses an internal register calling convention; the recovery exposes a portable function interface.
